At the right end of the spread, *The Free Press* avoided the electoral gains narrative almost entirely, instead running a headline focused on a campaign-adjacent content creator's alleged affinity for the Chinese Communist Party ("Loves the CCP"), a charged association that reframes the story around ideological suspicion rather than electoral progress. The contrast illustrates a classic divergence: left-leaning outlets centered momentum and strategy, while the right-leaning outlet redirected attention toward perceived foreign-aligned sympathies.
